name: Atmospheric color grading and mathematical Atkinson and Riemersma dithering
description: Verify drawing a solid colored ball and sprite, applying atmospheric mood color grades (Sunset, Moonlight, Neon), and executing mathematical error-diffusion dithering algorithms.

planSteps.description: Select the Ellipse tool (press O), ensure shape mode in context bar is 'Shape: Filled Solid', press down on canvas, drag diagonally for at least 150 pixels, and release to draw a prominent circle
Select the Flood Fill tool (press G), select a vibrant color, and click inside the circle to solidly fill and color it
Verify a solid colored circular ball is clearly visible on the canvas
Click the 'PixiBud AI' tab button in the right inspector panel
Verify the 'COLOR SCIENCE & MORPHING' section is visible
Verify the ball colors shift to a warm orange and amber twilight atmosphere
Click the 'Atkinson Dither' button in the color science panel
Verify MacPaint-style 75% error-diffusion dithering is applied across the ball
Verify Hilbert-curve space-filling error diffusion is applied cleanly across the layer
